observations.text: Four washes left pale horizontal lanes.
Crossing washes joined the pond.
Long reed was slender; leaf only a narrow trace.
Wider leaf read at whole scale; copper body was continuous.
Four wing gestures reserved green wedges; silhouettes narrow and angular.
Sampled curves broadened lower wings without closing gaps; hooked upper tip and regular bristles remained.
Paired eyes distinct; broader warm thorax sits above wing roots.
Long abdomen light gave volume; first legs angular.
Four curved legs stayed finer than first pair.
Leading wing veins visible without full outlines.
Single compact eye reflection remained visible whole.
Three short bands segmented abdomen; upper pan showed hooked wing tip.
Thin membrane glazes made pale threads while retaining relief.
Cross veins stayed subtle at whole scale.
Amber tip accents subordinate to eye.
Reed light side and node visible; leaf strap-like.
Sampled leaf fold more curved; node retained raised tab.
Watercolor passages faint, with one dark lower pool.
Thin oil ripples clearly visible where watercolor stayed faint.
Warm thorax neighbors shortened dark color but left relief.
Wing correction added pale relief faster than rounding tip.
Single darker wing pass changed little and retained ridge.
Cheek separated head and thorax; band/node correction subtle.
Final tail/eye/leaf/ripple refinements retained four green wing gaps and compact eye light. Stop: further layering chiefly adds relief.

limitations: At 8 strokes Whole painting click timed out but fresh accessibility state confirmed whole and settled pair was saved. At 12 close screenshot was saved but tool error hid display; it was viewed from disk in the next call. A disabled-pause wait failed after the 16-stroke batch; fresh check confirmed idle before paired review. Every boundary has saved whole and close screenshots. Center close views clip wing tips by design; upper/lower pans supplement them.
